title: [Core5G] Establish the Go/gRPC foundation and engineering workflow
body:
## Scope
Replace the prior application with the Core5G CDC V2.0 foundation.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Go module and versioned protobuf contracts
- [ ] Reproducible protobuf generation and container tooling
- [ ] Formatting, vet, unit/race tests in CI
- [ ] Contribution guide, roadmap, linked issues and reviewable PRs
- [ ] Prior project removed from the working tree; Git history retained

CDC phase 1. Validation: generated bindings, build, config tests and CI.

title: [Core5G] Implement UDM/AUSF/AMF registration and durable state
body:
## Scope
Implement synthetic subscriber profiles, fictional authentication and UE registration across gRPC services.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Known, unknown, disabled and invalid-credential subscribers
- [ ] Explicit UE state machine; duplicate/concurrent requests controlled
- [ ] Dependency timeout returns UE to DISCONNECTED
- [ ] Service-owned PostgreSQL schemas and atomic state transitions
- [ ] Unit/integration tests for F01/F02 and T01-T03

CDC phase 2. No real subscriber credentials or production 5G authentication.

title: [Core5G] Implement PDU sessions, IPAM and virtual packet traffic
body:
## Scope
Implement SMF and virtual UPF lifecycle, IP allocation and deterministic traffic simulation.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Registration required before session creation
- [ ] Idempotency by request_id and unique active IPs
- [ ] UPF failure compensation and safe IP reuse
- [ ] Idempotent release and rejection of inactive-session traffic
- [ ] Reproducible latency, jitter and loss with packet/byte counters
- [ ] Concurrency, resilience and lifecycle tests: F03/F04, T04-T09

CDC phase 3. Virtual packets only; no GTP-U.

title: [Core5G] Add simulator control API, dashboard and fault observability
body:
## Scope
Connect UE/gNB workflows to the services and expose local lab controls.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] REST endpoints for UE/session/traffic/simulation/fault controls
- [ ] Minimal responsive dashboard using real API responses
- [ ] Prometheus metrics, JSON logs and request/trace identifiers
- [ ] Liveness/readiness checks and configurable deadlines
- [ ] E2E nominal and injected-failure scenarios

CDC phase 4, F05. Control API is for a trusted local lab.

title: [Core5G] Deliver Compose/Kind deployment, load evidence and career-ready documentation
body:
## Scope
Make the simulator independently reproducible and document its actual validation results.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] One-command Compose startup with PostgreSQL, Prometheus and Grafana
- [ ] Kind/Kubernetes manifests and deployment instructions
- [ ] E2E acceptance scenarios T01-T09
- [ ] Reproducible 1000-UE workload and p50/p95/p99/error/hardware report
- [ ] go test, go vet, race checks and critical-package coverage evidence
- [ ] API reference, ADRs, architecture diagrams and demonstration guide
- [ ] Captures of a real run and explicit unverified items

CDC phase 5, NF01-NF08 and T10. Performance targets must never be presented as measured results without evidence.
